verdicts.quote: “The Gorgias API supports two authentication methods: 1. Private app → API key 2. Public app → OAuth2 … Using OAuth2 is mandatory for public apps.”
verdicts.reason: Public, multi-tenant apps are required to use OAuth2; API keys are only for private apps. ([developers.gorgias.com](https://developers.gorgias.com/reference/authentication))

verdicts.quote: “You need to follow a specific process… which includes setting up OAuth2… and a review of the app by the Gorgias team.”
verdicts.reason: Although anyone can self-serve a trial and API key, distributing a public OAuth app to multiple customers requires passing Gorgias’s app review, so access is app_review rather than self_serve_trial. ([docs.gorgias.com](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/build-a-custom-app-81853))

verdicts.quote: Scopes span many resources: “users… customers… tickets… custom_fields… events… integrations… jobs… macros… rules… satisfaction_survey… statistics… tags… apps.”
verdicts.reason: The scope list reflects numerous resource families across the product with read/write operations, indicating a broad API. ([developers.gorgias.com](https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/oauth2-scopes))

verdicts.quote: “The Gorgias MCP lets you work with your Gorgias helpdesk using an AI assistant, like Claude or ChatGPT.”
verdicts.reason: This is Gorgias’s own documentation for their MCP server (includes the remote URL), confirming an official MCP. ([docs.gorgias.com](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/connect-your-ai-assistant-to-the-gorgias-mcp-6310546))

verdicts.quote: “You don't need to follow any special process to create a private app.” … “You need to follow a specific process… and a review of the app by the Gorgias team.”
verdicts.reason: You can build and test today (private app/API keys), but publishing a multi-tenant OAuth app requires review, so it’s ready_with_caveats. ([docs.gorgias.com](https://docs.gorgias.com/en-US/build-a-custom-app-81853))
